# The blueprint primitives a bubbletea override renders through are declared
# in sngl:platform/bubbletea, so a call against one is checked like any
# other. Before, the platform's Resolve() minted a component
# for whatever name was written, carrying one untyped wildcard prop: every prop
# name, every prop value and every event name passed unchecked.

# A prop nobody declared is an error.
! sngl check badprop.sngl
stderr 'unknown prop "styl" on component Styled'

# So is an event. The wildcard sat on a prop, so event validation was skipped
# entirely — these primitives declare no events, and take none.
! sngl check badevent.sngl
stderr 'unknown event "bogus" on component Layout'

# A declared prop's type is checked. `join` selects the lipgloss axis and is a
# JoinDir, not a string.
! sngl check badtype.sngl
stderr 'cannot use string as JoinDir for prop "join" on component Layout'

# The primitives themselves still resolve.
sngl check good.sngl

-- badprop.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import bt "sngl:platform/bubbletea"

component main node {
    bt.Styled(content = "hi", styl = {}) {}
}

window {
    main
}
-- badevent.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import bt "sngl:platform/bubbletea"

component main node {
    bt.Layout(join = bt.JoinDir.vertical, @bogus { }) {}
}

window {
    main
}
-- badtype.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import bt "sngl:platform/bubbletea"

component main node {
    bt.Layout(join = "vertical") {}
}

window {
    main
}
-- good.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import bt "sngl:platform/bubbletea"

component main node {
    bt.Layout(join = bt.JoinDir.vertical) {
        bt.Styled(content = "hi") {}
    }
}

window {
    main
}
